# Middlebury College

> > Middlebury College's comprehensive academic resource hub covering advising methodologies, language learning resources, career development programs, and interdisciplinary research initiatives.

This site aggregates resources from Middlebury College and the Middlebury Institute of International Studies (MIIS), including academic advising frameworks, French language lexicons, DC-based career acceleration programs, and research on indigenous sovereignty and border studies.

## Key Topics

- Academic Advising Models
- Developmental Advising
- Prescriptive Advising
- Appreciative Advising
- French Literature and Lexique
- MIIS (Middlebury Institute of International Studies)
- DC Career Week
- Washington DC Recruiting
- Indigenous Borderlands
- Student-Advisor Partnership
- Literary Analysis Vocabulary
- Career Acceleration Programs
- Border Rites Research
- Language Learning Resources

## Academic Advising Resources

- [Advising Styles | Academic Advising Resources](https://sites.middlebury.edu/academicadvisingresources/sample-programs-styles/): Guide to academic advising models: prescriptive, developmental, appreciative

## Career Development & Professional Programs

- [DC Career Acceleration Week](https://sites.middlebury.edu/dcweek/): MIIS Washington DC career week with employer sessions and internships

## Language Learning & French Resources

- [03 L'action | LE LEXIQUE](https://sites.middlebury.edu/french-lexique/pour-parler-de-la-litterature/03-laction/): French vocabulary reference for discussing literary action and plot elements

## Research & Special Projects

- [Maps – Indigenous Borderlands and Border Rites](https://sites.middlebury.edu/borderrites/maps/): Indigenous cartography and US-Canada border sovereignty mapping resources
